itens.titulo: Petrobras: produção e alta do Brent devem favorecer resultado do 3º tri, apontam bancos
itens.descricao: Petrobras: produção e alta do Brent devem favorecer resultado do 3º tri, apontam bancos Bloomberg Linea Brasil
trechos: Bloomberg Línea — O aumento da produção de petróleo e a alta do Brent devem favorecer o resultado da Petrobras (PETR3, PETR4) no terceiro trimestre, apontam bancos de investimentos em relatório.
A divulgação do balanço da estatal está programado esta terça-feira (10), após o fechamento do mercado.
O consenso Bloomberg indica uma geração de caixa medida pelo lucro antes de juros, impostos, depreciação e amortização (Ebitda) de US$ 17,4 bilhões de julho a setembro.
No mesmo período do ano passado, a petroleira registrou um Ebitda ajustado de US$ 11,7 bilhões.

Bancos de investimento projetam crescimento para o indicador no terceiro trimestre em relação ao mesmo intervalo de 2025: o BTG estima US$ 19,18 bilhões; Goldman Sachs (US$ 16,6 bilhões) e Itaú BBA (US$ 17,9 bilhões).
As instituições projetam receita líquida de US$ 35,4 bilhões (BTG) e US$ 34 bilhões (Itaú BBA) para o trimestre.
O consenso Bloomberg aponta US$ 32,4 bilhões de receita para a companhia.
No mesmo período de 2025, o indicador da petroleira alcançou US$ 23,4 bilhões.

itens.titulo: Itaúsa (ITSA4) tem alta de 25% no lucro recorrente para R$ 5,1 bi no 3º trimestre
itens.descricao: Itaúsa (ITSA4) tem alta de 25% no lucro recorrente para R$ 5,1 bi no 3º trimestre InfoMoney
trechos: Publicidade SÃO PAULO, 9 Nov (Reuters) – A holding Itaúsa teve lucro líquido recorrente de R$ 5,1 bilhões no terceiro trimestre, crescimento de 25% sobre o resultado do mesmo período do ano passado, segundo balanço apresentado nesta segunda-feira.
O resultado do setor não financeiro da controladora do Itaú Unibanco mais que dobrou, passando de R$ 267 milhões para R$ 593 milhões no terceiro trimestre, puxado pela empresa de gasodutos NTS.
A NTS viu o resultado recorrente sair de R$ 84 milhões no terceiro trimestre do ano passado para R$ 213 milhões, segundo o balanço da holding.
A Dexco, de louças e metais sanitários e painéis de madeira, foi a única empresa do grupo a mostrar prejuízo (R$10 milhões) no período, segundo o resultado da Itaúsa.
A Itaúsa elevou a rentabilidade sobre patrimônio para 20,7% no terceiro trimestre, 2,4 pontos percentuais acima do apurado um ano antes.
Em termos recorrentes, o resultado foi de 21,1%.

itens.titulo: Inflation Data to Test Limits of Treasury Rally After Haven Bid
itens.descricao: Inflation Data to Test Limits of Treasury Rally After Haven Bid Yahoo Finance UK
trechos: As equities showed signs of stabilizing Monday, the 10-year yield ticked up to 4.88%, but remained well off levels above 5% reached last month.
That's down from the prior headline inflation print of 0.6% for September, the fastest pace in five months.

The data will be the last CPI report before the December Fed policy meeting, where the interest-rate swap market is pricing in more than an 80% chance of a quarter-point increase, with about two hikes seen by next summer.
The Fed raised rates in September, the first increase since 2023, after a surge in oil prices on the back of the US war against Iran helped spur inflation.

Prospects for inflation to come down to the Fed's 2% target in the longer term are making Olumide Owolabi, a senior portfolio manager at Neuberger Berman, hopeful that the current rally in Treasuries could continue.

itens.titulo: MARA Books $632M Q3 Profit, Sells 13,597 Bitcoin to Pay Down Debt
itens.descricao: MARA Books $632M Q3 Profit, Sells 13,597 Bitcoin to Pay Down Debt Yahoo Finance
trechos: Bitcoin miner and digital infrastructure company MARA Holdings (NASDAQ: $MARA) reported third-quarter net income of $632.1 million on Monday, driven by unrealized gains on its Bitcoin (CRYPTO: $BTC) holdings, even as revenue declined 35%.
The company also disclosed that it sold 13,597 Bitcoin after the quarter ended to repay its Bitcoin-backed loans.
MARA recorded an $885.3 million unrealized gain on its digital assets as Bitcoin appreciated 27% during the quarter.
Despite the quarterly profit, the company remains at a net loss of $1.24 billion for the first nine months of the year.
Revenue declined primarily because the average price of Bitcoin mined by MARA was 37% lower than a year earlier.
According to the company's shareholder letter, third-quarter revenue totaled $164.2 million, down from $252.4 million in the same period last year.
Bitcoin mining accounted for $83.1 million of the $88.2 million revenue decline.
Lower Bitcoin prices reduced mining revenue by $94.8 million, partially offset by a $11.7 million contribution from higher production.

itens.titulo: Jim Cramer says Nvidia investors need to prepare for a future without Jensen Huang
itens.descricao: Jim Cramer says Nvidia investors need to prepare for a future without Jensen Huang CNBC
trechos: Key Points - Jim Cramer warned that this long-standing "own it, don't trade it" status for Nvidia's stock could be at risk amid uncertainty surrounding CEO Jensen Huang's future.
"Given the facts of the story, which seem to get worse with each update, we are going to have to consider owning shares in a Jensen-less Nvidia," the " Mad Money " host said.
"What you need to know is that Nvidia is a less attractive stock than it was a week ago, even as I think the business remains strong," Cramer said.
It has maintained a consistent position since early 2019.
"We are not anxious to dump [Nvidia]," Cramer said about his Charitable Trust, citing what he believes to be Nvidia's deep management bench and established technological leadership .
"I think Nvidia can go forward just on the strength of its multiyear product map," he added.
As of June 30, Nvidia had equity stakes in CoreWeave and Nebius, according to its 13F securities securities filing .
In May, Nvidia announced a partnership with Iren that included warrants for up to 30 million shares.

itens.titulo: Prediction: This Will Be the Price of Bitcoin by the End of 2030
itens.descricao: Prediction: This Will Be the Price of Bitcoin by the End of 2030 Yahoo Finance
trechos: The days of triple-digit annual growth may be over, and that means it could be time to put those spectacular $1 million price predictions for Bitcoin on the shelf.
If that's the case, then the price of Bitcoin by the end of 2030 should stay below $150,000.
In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia.
For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia.
Given Bitcoin's steep 40% decline over the past 12 months, it's easy to see why investors, analysts, and crypto insiders are now ratcheting down their future price targets for Bitcoin.

Even Michael Saylor of Strategy (NASDAQ: MSTR) -- arguably the biggest Bitcoin bull on the planet -- is now suggesting that the world's most popular cryptocurrency may face difficulties getting back to $100,000.
According to the base case scenario from JPMorgan Asset Management, Bitcoin will grow at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 10% over the next 10 years.
In a bull-case scenario, Bitcoin will "only" grow at a 17% CAGR.
